phase_prompt.summary: The altar in its fully activated, default state.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A towering basalt altar carved with intertwined Ethiopian and Egyptian motifs, its surface etched with bio‑luminescent glyphs that pulse in sync with an unseen celestial rhythm. A central void houses a suspended crystalline core, refracting light into gold and azure, while copper latticework and polished obsidian panels reflect a low amber glow. Hidden mechanical conduits hum softly, hinting at advanced technology beneath the ancient stone, all rendered in photorealistic, tactile detail.
